lurk.name: Lurk
lurk.text: Lives in the dark and gets in anywhere: burglar, spy, saboteur, secret killer.
lurk.xpTrigger: Gain xp when you address a challenge with stealth or evasion.
list: What are they about to do?
How can I get them to [X]?
What should I look into more closely?
What is the best way in?

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.text: The quality and rank of security systems do not reduce your effect.

reflexes.name: Reflexes
reflexes.text: You act first in most situations and can interrupt an action already begun.

devils-footsteps.name: The Devil's Footsteps
devils-footsteps.text: Push yourself for athletics at the edge of the superhuman, or a maneuver that makes enemies strike each other.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.text: +1d when you attack from ambush or set a trap.

ghost-veil.name: Ghost Veil
ghost-veil.text: For 2 stress, briefly become intangible and shadow-like (+1 per extra boost).

daredevil.name: Daredevil
daredevil.text: +1d to a desperate roll if you accept -1d to resist its consequences.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.text: Special armor: resist consequences of guards and detection, or push yourself when leaping, running, climbing and hiding for free.

expertise.name: Expertise
expertise.text: Choose an action: when you lead a group action with it, you suffer at most 1 stress.

fine-lockpicks.name: Fine Lockpicks
fine-lockpicks.text: Tools for opening and bypassing locks.

fine-shadow-cloak.name: Fine Shadow Cloak
fine-shadow-cloak.text: A cloak of Iruvian shadow silk improves the effect of stealth.

light-climbing-gear.name: Light Climbing Gear
light-climbing-gear.text: Lighter than standard (ordinary gear has load 2).

lurk-silence-potion.name: Silence Potion
lurk-silence-potion.text: Muffles sounds within 10 paces of the drinker for a few moments.

dark-vision-goggles.name: Dark-Vision Goggles
dark-vision-goggles.text: A magical device: you see in the dark as in good light.

telda.name: Telda
telda.text: Perhaps your teacher in thieving, or a rival.

darmot.name: Darmot
darmot.text: A veteran officer who got in your way, or an old friend on the law side.

frake.name: Frake
frake.text: A lock consultant, or a craftsman who designs impregnable locks.

roslyn-kellis.name: Roslyn Kellis
roslyn-kellis.text: An old friend, or a victim of your spying thirsting for revenge.

petra.name: Petra
petra.text: Perhaps a good source of information.
